name: Nocobase
description: NocoBase is the most extensible AI-powered no-code/low-code platform.
composeYaml:
services:
  nocobase:
    image: 'nocobase/nocobase:1.9.33'
    environment:
      - 'APP_KEY=${APPKEY}'
      - DB_DIALECT=postgres
      - DB_HOST=postgres
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - 'DB_DATABASE=${POSTGRES_DB:-nocobase-db}'
      - DB_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - DB_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - 'nocobase-storage:/app/nocobase/storage'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: 'postgres:17-alpine'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-nocobase-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
